title: Bashar :: The 40 Year Cycles of Human Evolution - Highlights
author: Bashar Channeled by Darryl Anka
opening_summary: Bashar discusses 40-year cycles as typical timeframes in which humanity transforms from one paradigm to another. The bulk of the transcript focuses on a freelancer's concern about income gaps between projects. Bashar addresses the listener's fear-based thinking, explaining that basing one's future on past negative experiences limits possibilities. He emphasizes that acting on passion attracts support in multiple forms, that abundance means having capacity to do what's needed when needed, and that vibrational energy physics ensures what you put out returns to you—a mechanism operating regardless of conscious belief.

qa_topics.question: How can I avoid income gaps when working freelance?
qa_topics.answer_gist: Charge more, pursue diverse projects, find passion work between gigs. Support flows when acting on authentic passion; broaden your definition of support beyond money.

qa_topics.question: Why am I afraid freelancing won't support me?
qa_topics.answer_gist: You lack built-in understanding that passion-driven action creates abundance. Past failure doesn't determine future if you act differently; don't limit yourself by fear-based definitions.

qa_topics.question: What does abundance actually mean?
qa_topics.answer_gist: Abundance is the ability to do what you need when you need it. Support materializes through multiple forms; it's physics-based vibrational energy, not wishful thinking or mystery.

quotes.quote: Do not base your future on what you experienced in the past.
quotes.context: Overcoming fear from previous job loss

quotes.quote: Abundance is the ability to do what you need to do when you need to do it.
This is physics. What you put out is what you get back.
You don't actually have inbuilt understanding that passion will support you.
